title: Egg
content:
# Egg

Type: Material | Internal ID: ChickenEgg | Source: Haldor | Hen | Usage: Cauldron | Buy: 1,500, Coins | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Egg is an item and a food source, which can be initially purchased from Haldor to be able to breed Chickens. In order to start a chicken farm, two eggs are required.
It can be cooked in a Cauldron to obtain a Cooked egg.

## Availability

• Purchased from Haldor for 1,500 Coins after defeating Yagluth.
• Found in a chest in the bottom floor of the Sealed Tower structure in the Plains.
• Naturally spawns if two Hens are well-fed, sheltered, and near each other.

### Crafting

• Cooked egg
• Mushroom omelette

### Hatching

An egg must be placed (dropped from inventory) near a fire or heat source and under a roof (needs shelter) to hatch. When hovering over an egg, it will indicate whether it is too cold to hatch (note: hovertext may take 5-10 seconds to update). After 30 minutes, the egg will hatch, and a Chicken will spawn and will eventually grow into a Hen. The egg must be placed individually - not in a stack - to hatch.

Categorias: Materials, Food, Cooking recipes
